label: Incidence-coherent coefficient-complex frontier
summary: Across sectors, labelled presentations become admissible coefficient objects only through incidence, descent, and homotopy coherence; supported physical readout remains a further typed operation.

Unquotiented fiber-linear numerator freedom saturates a 700-sample oracle, so source/Koszul coherence must precede further rank interpretation.
